problem.matrix: 65 seeded permutations of 40000 columns assigned to 10000 rows (duplicates summed), Gaussian values with standard deviation 1/sqrt(260)

formulation: sepA: residual r = D w - x materialized as its own step, gradient applied as D^T r; D^T D never formed (only this formulation)
baseline_gate: baseline_gate.txt: hand-written SciPy iteration agrees with FOMTools' reference execution to 2.665e-15 (ISTA) and 1.724e-08 (FISTA) after 200 iterations

baselines.scipy: hand-written ISTA/FISTA with D and D^T (CSR), one CPU core (SciPy's sparse products are single-threaded), 1 warm-up + 3 solves, median
baselines.cupy: hand-written ISTA/FISTA with D and D^T on the GPU (cuSPARSE SpMV), 8 warm-ups + 10 solves, mean, includes solution download

measurement.allocation: one Slurm job, 16 cores and one A100 on della-i12g1, prep and seven rounds back to back

agent: FOMTools default agent driver with built-in phase_a_instructions / phase_b_instructions
agent_nodes: AMD EPYC 7413 + NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (della-l07g5, della-l08g1, della-l07g3, della-l08g3, della-l09g2)
